jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.  

As a Product Manager in Consumer \& Community Banking , Identity Team, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.  

**Job responsibilities*** Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition
* Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability
**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** 8\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* Analytical Mindset, Experience in Identity/Fraud Risk
**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:*** Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.
* Platform/Product Experience, Worked on risk models with data scientists .

Morgan and Chase brands. Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. ABOUT AMGEN


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.


ABOUT THE ROLE


Role Description:


Amgen is seeking a **Sr. Associate Software Developer** to contribute to the design, development, and deployment of advanced Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions. The role focuses on creating responsive, secure, and scalable web applications that integrate seamlessly with enterprise identity platforms.


This position will involve hands\-on development across both front\-end and back\-end technologies, building APIs, ensuring compliance with security best practices, and deploying cloud\-native solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with product owners, architects, and agile teams to deliver high\-quality, user\-centric CIAM solutions that enhance customer experience and safeguard data.


Roles \& Responsibilities:

* End\-to\-End Ownership: Take ownership of complex software projects from conception to deployment, managing scope, risks, and timelines.
* Front\-End Development: Design and implement responsive, accessible, and visually appealing user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks (React.js, Angular, or Vue.js).
* Back\-End Development: Build and optimize scalable server\-side logic and APIs using Node.js, Express.js, or Python, ensuring secure integration with databases and microservices.
* Database Design \& Management: Design, develop, and maintain SQL/NoSQL databases, focusing on security, performance, and reliability.
* API Development: Create RESTful or GraphQL APIs for communication between front\-end, back\-end, and external systems.
* Cross\-Browser \& Cross\-Platform Compatibility: Ensure applications run seamlessly across multiple browsers, devices, and platforms.
* Generative AI \& Innovation: Develop innovative solutions leveraging generative AI technologies to enhance applications and workflows.
* Cloud Deployment \& Management: Deploy, manage, and scale applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); apply DevOps and CI/CD best practices.
* Software Architecture \& Documentation: Design software architecture and produce technical documentation on system design, deployment, integration, disaster recovery, and operations.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Develop and execute unit, integration, and performance tests; conduct code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to best practices.
* Performance Optimization: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve performance issues, technical challenges, and software bugs effectively.
* Security Best Practices: Implement authentication, authorization, encryption, and protect against vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection.
* System Integration: Work on integrating applications with other systems and platforms for seamless data flow and enhanced functionality.
* Customization \& Enhancements: Design, develop, and customize application modules, interfaces, and reports to meet specific business requirements.
* Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in SAFE Agile ceremonies, collaborating with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to ensure on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Mentorship \& Leadership: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and engineering peers.
* Rapid Prototyping: Translate concepts and requirements quickly into functional prototypes to validate ideas and solutions.
* Continuous Learning \& Trend Awareness: Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving best practices, applying them to improve solutions.
* Operational Support \& Maintenance: Provide ongoing support for deployed applications, ensuring smooth operations, reliability, and scalability.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:

**\[GCF Level 4A]**

* Master’s degree and 1 to 3 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 3 to 5 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience OR
* Diploma and 7 to 9 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience

Functional Skills:

**Must\-Have Skills (Not more than 3 to 4\):**

* Hands on experience with various cloud services, understand pros and cons of various cloud services in well architected cloud design principles
* Hands on experience with Full Stack software development. Proficient in programming language Python(preferred), JavaScript,React.js/Node.js/Express.js SQL/NoSQL.
* Strong problem solving, analytical skills; Ability to learn quickly; Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Experienced with API integration, serverless, microservices architecture.
**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Hands\-on experience building RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of application performance monitoring and optimization.

Professional Certifications (please mention if the certification is preferred or mandatory for the role):

* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner(preferred)

Soft Skills:

* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
* High degree of initiative and self\-motivation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully
* Team\-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Director – Group Product Manager, Data \& AI Studio Capability will lead the **end\-to\-end product portfolio for the Data \& AI Studio**, a foundational capability that enables development, deployment, and operation of enterprise data and AI products.


The Data \& AI Studio serves as a **core enablement layer powering multiple products and use cases**, providing standardized capabilities across data ingestion, processing, transformation, and AI/ML development and orchestration.


This role is accountable for **product strategy, execution, adoption, and value realization** of the Studio capability, ensuring it operates as a **scalable, reusable, and platform\-aligned product ecosystem**. The role also carries **full P\&L accountability**, including investment decisions, prioritization, and value delivery across the portfolio.


The Director will lead a team of **product managers and architects**, working closely with engineering, enterprise platform teams, and enterprise architecture to deliver consistent, high\-impact outcomes.

We are looking for a highly motivated Field Sales Executive to drive merchant engagement, business growth, and transaction volume across an assigned territory. This role is ideal for sales professionals who thrive in a field\-based environment, enjoy building strong business relationships, and have a proven track record of achieving ambitious sales targets.



As a Field Sales Executive, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of retail merchants, ensuring consistent product adoption, and maximizing transaction volumes within your assigned geography. The role requires regular interaction with merchants, understanding their business needs, addressing concerns, and driving long\-term engagement through effective relationship management.



You will act as the primary point of contact for merchants, helping them leverage digital solutions to improve their business operations and customer experience. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, commercial acumen, negotiation abilities, and a results\-driven mindset. The ideal candidate is confident, self\-motivated, and capable of building trust\-based relationships while consistently delivering business objectives.



This position offers an exciting opportunity to work directly with merchants, contribute to market expansion, and play a critical role in driving business growth through customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio development.



**Requirements**
----------------


### **Key Responsibilities**


### **Merchant Relationship Management**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with merchants across the assigned territory.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for merchant queries, concerns, and business requirements.
* Conduct regular merchant visits as per the planned sales schedule and maintain consistent engagement.
* Develop trust\-based partnerships that drive long\-term business growth and customer retention.
* Ensure high levels of merchant satisfaction through proactive support and relationship management.

### **Sales \& Business Development**


* Drive adoption and usage of business solutions among assigned merchants.
* Identify opportunities to increase transaction volumes and business penetration within existing accounts.
* Generate new business opportunities through merchant referrals, networking, and market outreach activities.
* Influence merchant decision\-makers and frontline teams to maximize product utilization.
* Consistently achieve assigned sales, revenue, and transaction targets.

### **Account Growth \& Portfolio Management**


* Manage and grow a portfolio of merchants by increasing engagement and business contribution.
* Monitor merchant performance and identify opportunities for growth and expansion.
* Support merchants in understanding product benefits, commercial advantages, and business value.
* Drive repeat business and long\-term account development through regular follow\-ups.
* Ensure strong portfolio health through proactive account management practices.

### **Market Intelligence \& Competitive Insights**


* Gather market feedback and customer insights from the field.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and emerging business opportunities.
* Share actionable intelligence with leadership teams to support strategic decision\-making.
* Identify challenges impacting merchant adoption and recommend practical solutions.
* Stay updated on industry developments and evolving customer needs.

### **Target Achievement \& Performance Management**


* Meet or exceed assigned business, revenue, and transaction goals.
* Maintain accurate records of merchant interactions, sales activities, and business performance.
* Track key performance metrics and provide regular updates to management.
* Develop action plans to address performance gaps and improve business outcomes.
* Take ownership of territory performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

### **What Makes You a Great Fit**


* 3–4 years of proven field sales experience in B2B environments.
* Strong experience working with retail merchants, general trade businesses, or channel\-driven sales models.
* Background in industries such as Telecom, Banking, SaaS, Billing Solutions, or related sectors is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated success in customer acquisition, account management, and revenue generation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at different levels.
* Strong spoken and written communication abilities, including professional business interactions.
* High confidence, resilience, and the ability to work independently in a target\-driven environment.
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building capabilities.

**What you will do**


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.


In this vital role as **Data Engineer** at Amgen, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data solutions that enable trusted insights and support critical business decisions.


This position is **focused on supporting the OUS Field Engagement Team**, working closely with stakeholders across the **JAPAC and ELMAC regions**. You will collaborate with global and regional teams to deliver data solutions that support field operations, customer engagement, and analytics use cases in a complex, multi\-region environment.


You will work in an Agile (SAFe) environment, contribute to supporting enterprise data initiatives primarily built on **Informatica ETL**, including the **future migration from Informatica to Databricks**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and optimize **ETL pipelines using Informatica**, ensuring high data quality, performance, and reliability
* Support and contribute to the **future transition of Informatica workloads to Databricks** (Spark, Delta Lake)
* Build and enhance data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and processing of large\-scale datasets supporting **OUS Field Engagement use cases**
* Collaborate with Data Architects, Business SMEs, Product Owners, and Senior Data Engineers across **JAPAC and ELMAC regions** to deliver end\-to\-end data solutions
* Participate actively in a **SAFe/Agile team**, contributing to PI planning, sprint execution, and continuous improvement
* Support **data governance, metadata management, and data quality initiatives**
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex data issues across systems
* Apply best practices for coding, testing, documentation, and reusable component design
* Translate business and technical requirements into well\-structured development tasks
* Execute unit and integration testing to ensure solution robustness and compliance with quality standards
* Monitor data pipelines and applications, supporting ongoing maintenance and performance optimization
* Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps practices for data engineering solutions
* Mentor junior team members and promote data engineering best practices

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, IT, or a related field
* **4–7 years of relevant data engineering experience**, with strong hands\-on ETL background

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong experience with **Informatica (PowerCenter, IICS)**
* Exposure to **Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, or Spark SQL**
* Familiarity with **SAFe or Agile delivery models**
* Experience or exposure to **Master Data Management (MDM)**
* Experience with **Veeva systems** (nice to have)
* Experience supporting **Field Engagement or Commercial data domains** (preferred)

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Advanced ETL development experience, particularly with **Informatica**
* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and analysis
* Solid understanding of data modeling and entity relationships
* Working knowledge of Python and/or PySpark
* Experience supporting production data pipelines and resolving data issues
* Ability to work effectively in **global, cross\-regional teams**

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including with **global stakeholders across regions**
* Proven team player with experience in Agile/SAFe environments
* High attention to detail and commitment to data quality
* Ability to manage priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment
* Willingness to mentor junior engineers and share knowledge
* Adaptable to evolving technologies and business needs

**Job Description**
***About Sanofi***
 We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
   

  

**About The Job**
 At Sanofi, we’re committed to providing the next\-gen healthcare that patients and customers need. The Digital Launch \& Market Product team ( LMP) is one of the key vertical towers within Digital R\&D, includes product line teams to serve global regulatory Affairs ( GRA),
 **Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV)** 
 , R\&D CMO/Medical etc. domains. We focus on delivery of innovative digital products to support and accelerate product launches, accelerating cycle times to bring medicines to patients faster while improving operational efficiency and ensure regulatory compliance.
   

  

 This position operates within Sanofi Digital R\&D \- Digital Launch \& Market Product (LMP) \- Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) Product Line whose mission is to help improve Patient Safety with AI and automation enabled Digital Solutions.
   

  

 As
 **Digital Product Owner** 
 , you will be accountable to:
 ***Define \- strategy and roadmap** 
 ,
 **Drive \- delivery and management, Measure \- value and impact***
**of the Digital Product.**
**Main Responsibilities –**
* Product Vision
+ Set and communicate \- the vision for the product, working closely with Digital and Business Leadership and key stakeholders.
+ Ensure vision is aligned with Company strategic direction.
+ Manage strong relationships and partnerships with Digital R\&D verticals and across Business functions, that interact with Portfolio management and decision\-making.
+ Stay current in industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in Product management.
+ Identify opportunities for process improvement using AI and automation.
+ Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the product team

* Product Delivery
+ Define clear and actionable goals to deliver incremental value.
+ Lead delivery of Product from conception, MVP(minimum viable product) through continuous improvements.
+ Define, implement and lead Governance around the Digital Product \- to ensure best practices are followed, prioritizations aligned, value realized, risks managed.
+ Ensure collaboration with the architecture, Digital Data and AI, and digital R\&D Data Product and Platform teams
+ Ensure Agile framework and methodologies are followed, to deliver incremental value.
+ Manage backlog prioritization, balancing short\-term deliverables with long\-term goals and breakthrough ideas.
+ Champion modern AI tooling to accelerate design, testing, and iteration.

* Product Value
+ Ensure AI\-driven insights, automated workflows are integrated in the product and aligns with user journey – data, process, people.
+ Drive user adoption by delivering intuitive, user\-centric solutions. Gathering regular feedback, monitoring usage metrics, user satisfaction.
+ Ensure each sprint delivers measurable improvements to cycle times, internal productivity, quality and compliance, user experience.
+ Deliver Continuous improvement in changing digital landscape, regulatory requirements and business strategy.
+ Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases


**About You**
**Education \& Experience:**
* 10\+ IT industry experience with 5\+ years of experience working in Digital Product delivery and leadership as a product owner or product manager
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or STEM related field. Master degree is preferred.
* Experience in pharmaceutical industry with knowledge of pharmaceutical Drug lifecycle, R\&D value chain.
* Functional and technical expertise in the Pharmacovigilance ( PV) domain is highly desirable.
* Experience of software development in a GxP regulated environment is a strong plus.


**Key Skills**
* Expertise in leading cross\-functional teams to create Digital Strategies and Implementation roadmaps. Distinctive focus on solution objectives and application of product methodologies.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical designs and solutions, with a strong business and technical acumen
* Experienced in complex solution implementation \& delivery in agile.
* Demonstrated track record of designing, developing, and delivering transformative digital products – particularly in the AI space is a strong plus.
* Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
* Demonstrate product value through measurable use cases
* Strong technical/functional background, with the ability to understand and communicate complex functional/technical concepts.
* Solid knowledge and experience of Lean \& Agile practices, UX/UI and Application Design \& Integration

jobs.description:
**About CleanHarbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by
 **Mr. Alan S. McKim.**
 Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Job Title: Product Owner**
**Experience: 12\+ Years with Min 5 years as Product Owner**
**Location: Hyderabad, Hybrid**
**Working Hours: 12\.00pm to 9\.00pm**
**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with engineering teams to implement new features and improvements
* Understands UX/UI components, wire\-framing elements and design. Knowledge of Figma. Lucid, etc..
* Apply prompt engineering techniques for wireframing and design.
* Excellent verbal/written communication skills and presenting ideas in group setting.
* Prior experience with Atlassian products including JIRA and Confluence
* Authors Epics and Stories with detailed acceptance criteria for enhancement requests that address stakeholder business problems
* Works closely with delivery teams \& business analysts to translate business requirements into workable product backlogs
* Partners closely with the Scrum Masters on sprint planning, including prioritizing stories that have the highest business value and are aligned with enterprise standards and business roadmaps.
* Use lean, iterative experiments and low\-fidelity prototyping to find signal, validate hypothesis, and iterate before moving to scale
* Collaborate with partners to define end\-state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant, and scalable technology solutions
* Assess opportunities for reusing enterprise solutions and build new platforms with enterprise scalability in mind
* Develop and maintain an appropriately prioritized backlog of user stories for implementation. A keen curiosity about emerging tools and technologies
* Understands the enterprise IT processes and works closely with stakeholders to identify appropriate solutions to business problems.
* Determines scope, estimates work effort, and determines duration of development activities.
* Designs solutions to meet business requirements and works in close coordination with architects and delivery leads to drive solutions to production
* Owns and updates the product vision and roadmaps.
* Collaborates with the agile team to prepare the estimates for the user stories within the product backlog.
* Conducts the formal review and acceptance of user stories implemented by the agile team within a sprint.
* Drives the execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) activities with support from business and technology team members.
* Provides daily support to the application / Product platform; including, integrations and administration


**Qualifications**
* Proven experience as a Technology Product Owner in developing tech platforms for underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes or Insurtech, with a solid understanding of insurance products, processes, and customer needs.

Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. As the core gaming identity for Google Play, the Gamer Profile is the critical connective tissue linking billions of users to the platform and the broader global gaming community.


In this role, you will directly architect and shape the end\-to\-end user journey on a global gaming platform of massive scale. You will collaborate closely with a cross\-functional squad of Product Managers, UX Designers, TPMs, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to design a seamless social ecosystem for players. You will architect and build highly engaging, interactive features that drive player discovery and community connection across multiple high\-traffic surfaces on Google Play. You will also leverage technologies to architect a robust technical stack that ensures the stability and low latency required for high\-impact, player\-facing features.
Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.

 Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
   

  

 Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
   

  

 We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
   

  

 But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

 We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Market \& Customer Understanding: Understand the e\-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.

Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Hiring Primitives
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The product team owns Rippling’s product direction, defining what to build in order to solve customer problems in a way that allows them to succeed and for our business to thrive. We do this by distilling insights from user research, product\-generated data, competitive analysis, and a deep market understanding. These insights allow us to prioritize the features we work on, which we define end to end with our design and engineering counterparts, to create our roadmap. As the features on this roadmap get developed, we partner with various teams to ensure they are ready to sell, service, and support them. We iterate on these features using data and customer feedback to make sure that they fulfill and surpass the goals we had when we decided to build them.
   

  

 In this role, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Rippling's hiring primitives platform. Your mission is to build the systems that make enterprise and global hiring adaptable, configurable, and scalable across countries, entities, worker types, and employment models. Success means enabling customers to hire and manage employees anywhere in the world through a flexible platform that supports country\-specific requirements while maintaining a unified product experience. You will partner closely with engineering, design, legal, compliance, operations, and go\-to\-market teams to define and launch foundational hiring capabilities used across HRIS, EOR, and Payroll products.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the roadmap and execution for Rippling's global hiring primitives and workforce configuration platform.
* Understand in detail the legal, compliance, operational, and regulatory requirements related to an employee’s early lifecycle.
* Build foundational capabilities that enable enterprise and global hiring to be adaptable and customizable across countries and entities.
* Conduct market research and customer analysis to understand what will need to be built and how to prioritize it for each country.
* Go beyond just shipping new countries; you obsess about continuous improvement and can optimize for shipping a portfolio of small, medium, and large releases.
* Do whatever it takes to make your countries and team successful, no matter how big or small the issue may be.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, other product teams, operations, legal, and compliance, to ensure successful product development and launch.
* Define product requirements and create detailed specifications, user stories, and wireframes to guide development.
* Participate in agile software development processes and work with the engineering team to ensure the product is delivered on time and within budget.
* Communicate with key stakeholders, including customers, sales, marketing, and customer support, to gather feedback and ensure that the product meets their needs.
* Oversee the testing and quality assurance of the payroll product, including conducting user acceptance testing.


**What You Will Need**
* 4\+ years of Product Management experience
* Self\-starter with a bias toward action
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Possess a deep sense of ownership and responsibility and understand that the buck stops with you.
* Endless curiosity and a love of the nitty\-gritty details
* Owned a successful product from inception to launch
* Strong ability to motivate and inspire people to do their best work
* Relentlessly focused on customers’ needs
* Exceptional interpersonal communication, relationship management, and organizational skills
* Deep analytical, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong alignment with our core values: We Run Hard, We Push the Limits of Possible, and Never Not My Problem

 Overview:
   

  

 SymphonyAI is at the forefront of innovation, leveraging cutting\-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to transform industries and drive business growth. As a global leader in AI\-powered solutions, we empower organizations to harness the full potential of data\-driven insights. SymphonyAI enterprise applications rapidly deliver transformative business value across retail, CPG, financial services, manufacturing, media, Enterprise IT (SymphonyAI Summit) and the public sector. jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**About Bluevine**
 Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best\-in\-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best.
   

  

 Since 2013, we’ve supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500\+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed.
   

  

 We’re innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you’ll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what’s next?
   

  

***This is a hybrid role* 
*.***
 At Bluevine, we pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, which we believe is best maintained through in\-person interactions and a vibrant office environment. All of our offices have reopened in accordance with local guidelines, and are following a hybrid model. In\-office days will be determined by location and discipline.
   

  

**About the role:**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Manager to join our dynamic product team. In this critical role, you will be the end\-to\-end owner of our proprietary internal tools that powers our daily business operations. You will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and strategic roadmap. You will collaborate closely with the Risk, Customer Success and Compliance teams to ensure seamless product performance, and ops efficiency across our global teams. This position is ideal for a fintech veteran who understands how to bridge the gap between complex backend platform data and the front\-end operational workflows that drive business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Ownership: Lead the development and maintenance of Bluevine’s Internal tools and all associated features. Act as the primary owner of data sync for different systems, ensuring data integrity and real\-time consistency across all systems.
* Workflow Optimization: Partner closely with Risk, CS, and other ops teams to automate and optimize high\-stakes workflows that directly impact our ability to scale.
* Compliance \& Security: Collaborate with Legal and Compliance (LnC) to define Role\-Based Access Controls (RBAC), manage sensitive data visibility
* Engineering Partnership: Act as the direct counterpart to a dedicated engineering team. You will work with the team to groom and plan efficiently, ensuring the team is focused on high\-leverage features and a robust pipeline.
* Advocate for the Internal User: Obsess over the "Operational Experience" for our global teams, using shadowing and qualitative feedback to reduce task completion time and cognitive load
* Problem Solving: Identify and resolve synchronization bottlenecks or tool\-based inefficiencies that hinder the productivity of our Ops teams.


**Required Knowledge And Experience**
* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, data analysis or a related field
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in the fintech industry or data management products. knowledge of financial and accounting flows is a strong advantage
* Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of operational workflows and financial data flows.


**Technical Skills**
* Data Management: Proficiency in SQL and a strong understanding of API integrations and data synchronization logic.
* Platform Thinking: Ability to translate operational "pain points" into scalable platform features.
* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret data and make data\-driven decisions regarding feature prioritization and system health.
* Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects using tools like Jira; comfortable working in an Agile environment.


**Communication:** 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to explain technical platform concepts to non\-technical Ops and Sales stakeholders.
   

  

**Benefits \& Perks**
* Excellent group health coverage and life insurance
* Stock options
* Meal allowance
* Transportation assistance (terms and conditions apply)
* Generous paid time off plan, Holidays
* Company\-sponsored mental health benefits
* Financial advisory services for both short\- and long\-term goals
* Learning and development opportunities to support career growth
* Community\-based volunteering opportunities

With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.

Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time.  As Glean’s Connectors PM, you’ll expand Glean’s connectors library, improve and deepen our existing product integrations, and improve our Indexing API and custom connector capabilities.

jobs.description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 





**Job summary** 






 Platform common services are the common, generic utilities that are available to every tenant/application/solution that deploys on the DigiCert® ONE platform. This role will take immediate ownership of existing services, and contribute to the definition, design and planning for future services.
 





 This role will partner closely with all Product teams and associated stakeholders at DigiCert to understand their business and technical requirements that potentially express dependencies on Platform Common Services. This role will collaborate with product teams across the portfolio, manage the delivery and success of platform components in a data\-driven manner, and drive priorities that maximize platform value to both internal and external customers. The Senior Platform Product Manager participates in strategic and tactical activities for medium\-to\-large projects with complex cross\-portfolio and cross\-functional requirements. They serve as the champion for their assigned area(s) and may serve as product owner for one or more development teams. This is a high\-visibility role with the potential to participate in and drive initiatives at all levels across the organization. Individuals in this role may participate in mentoring lower\-level contributors and learn how to help grow others in their careers.

 The Senior Platform Product Manager, Common Services will establish a backlog of portfolio requirements that express dependencies on Platform common services and actively maintain a prioritized stack\-ranking to inform their executable roadmap. * Exercises leadership as product champion to build the sense of “team” necessary to guide projects to a successful outcome and to set proper urgency/energy levels as appropriate o Models and fosters company values across delivery teams to ensure overall team and project success
* Works with peers in Product Management and Engineering to regularly identify and implement ways to improve collaboration and operational aspects of product, platform and cross\-functional operations




 Outbound Elements: 
 



* Contributes to the platform market vision, strategy, planning, and execution
* Supports sales to provide deal support and to have conversations with customers and prospects to gain a depth of understanding of their business requirements, to solicit participation in proof of concepts, beta releases, and advisory counsels
* Participates as necessary in conversations with Finance to develop Pricing and Packaging strategies
* Participates as necessary in conversations with Marketing to develop GTM strategy, messaging, positioning and supporting artifacts




 Experience/Competencies/Skills:
 



* Demonstrated ability to drive cooperation and alignment across product portfolio solutions and organizational functions in support of Platform Objectives

* Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with customers and gain trust and respect.
* Knowledge and use of technical, market and customer research methodologies
* Strong written and oral communication skills for internal audiences and externally with customers. They are a trusted voice of product
* Technical aptitude capable of comprehending target customer IT infrastructure, products and services at the system, data flow and API level, the ins and outs of development, design, agile framework, software development, and scrum approach.
* Highly detail\-oriented and able to manage many tasks for multiple requesters simultaneously
* Ability to foster credibility amongst peers, to find common ground and solve problems for the go…

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.job_function: Information Technology, Engineering, and Product Management
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE: Principal Product Manager** 




 As a Principal Product Manager at Aviatrix, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert and thought leader, owning the strategy and long\-term vision for a set of interrelated features and solution areas within our multi\-cloud networking platform. You will drive significant initiatives that shape product value and market differentiation, influencing the product roadmap at the leadership level.
 



 Working closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and customers, you will identify emerging opportunities, make high\-stakes prioritization decisions, and lead cross\-functional collaboration that defines Aviatrix's competitive position across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and beyond.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Own and drive the long\-term vision and comprehensive strategy for a set of interrelated features and solution areas, aligning them to the product's strategic goals, market position, and overall company vision.
* Influence the product roadmap at the leadership level by identifying future opportunities based on emerging industry trends, evolving user needs, and the competitive landscape.
* Engage regularly with enterprise customers, many of whom are based in the U.S., participating in product discussions, roadmap reviews, and strategic sessions; flexibility to schedule and attend meetings across time zones is expected.
* Establish prioritization frameworks for interdependent features that are adopted across product teams, and communicate rationale clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Make critical, high\-stakes decisions on feature scope and strategic direction, balancing cross\-functional input, market insights, and risk assessment to drive outcomes that impact the broader Product Management function.
* Lead execution across multiple interrelated features, overseeing project roadmaps, assigning responsibilities across teams, and establishing standards for quality delivery.
* Anticipate execution risks and adapt plans proactively based on resource or market changes, ensuring smooth cross\-functional collaboration.
* Maintain deep customer focus by synthesizing feedback and real\-world enterprise challenges into strategic product decisions, ensuring Aviatrix solutions address critical pain points at scale.
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep Aviatrix at the forefront of enterprise cloud networking and security.
* Drive strategic\-level communication across functions, providing detailed roadmap updates, vision presentations, and reports to leadership and executive teams.
* Partner with ecosystem partners and internal teams to validate strategy and deliver measurable, impactful results.
* Evangelize Aviatrix's solutions as an internal and external subject matter expert through thought leadership, technical white papers, webinars, and speaking engagements.
* Mentor and develop junior product managers on execution, collaboration, and strategic thinking best practices.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in product management within the cloud or networking domain, with a demonstrated track record of driving product strategy at scale (or 8\+ years with a Master's degree).
* Broad expertise and deep specialization in cloud networking technologies, including VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, firewalls, routing protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, IPSec, and cloud\-native networking across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Proven experience leading strategy and execution for a set of interrelated features or product areas, with direct influence on long\-term product roadmap and business outcomes.
* Experience with multi\-cloud architectures, networking protocols, and infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
* Hands\-on experience with at least two major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Networking, Azure Networking, Google Cloud Networking).
* Recognized ability to lead cross\-functional collaboration, build consensus, and influence stakeholders up to the executive level.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into strategic narratives for diverse audiences, including C\-suite.
* Experience mentoring and developing junior product managers.
* Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to accommodate meetings with customers and stakeholders based in the U.S. and other global time zones.

The Opportunity
   

  

 Sitetracker is on a mission to accelerate the transition to a fully connected and sustainable future. We are at an exciting phase of our product journey and are seeking a customer\- and market\-centric Sr. Product Manager to join our team and contribute to our continued growth. At Sitetracker, our product leaders drive the value we provide to the market. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on how our customers plan, develop, build and operate their assets. Come join an organisation committed to excellence and focused on accountability and outcomes.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Sr. Product Manager at Sitetracker, you will hit the ground running and make an immediate impact by partnering closely with our customers to uncover and shape new product investment opportunities that drive measurable value in our target markets. You’ll build a deep understanding of customer needs and market dynamics, aligning investments with specific product outcomes that advance our strategy. With a sharp focus on prioritisation, you will manage product initiatives from concept to execution—translating complex problems into clear goals and measurable targets. Collaborating with stakeholders, you will champion adoption, ensure tangible results, and accelerate Sitetracker’s impact in the industries we serve.
   

  

**The Skills You’ll Have:**
**Product Discovery:**
 Ability to identify important problems to solve through targeted customer discovery
   

  

 Effective with a variety of research techniques
   

  

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to interview customers using their language and terminology
   

  

**Roadmap \& Prioritization**
 Prioritise based on value provided, strategic alignment and delivery risk
   

  

 Ability to build a business model that aligns with the required product investment
   

  

 Ability to define goals, success metrics and outcomes for each initiative
   

  

 Ability to develop a product positioning guide that communicates the value proposition of the product
   

  

 Constant and consistent validation of previous product investments to ensure outcomes are achieved
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Manage product stakeholders (sales, customer success, engineering, product design) effectively to gain alignment
   

  

 Ability to confidently communicate priorities internally and externally
   

  

**Product**
 Requirements Definition
   

  

 Ability to document product needs through a well thought out PRD Ability to break down a problem into increments that have value in the marketplace
   

  

 Aligning products with buyer and user personas to define an ideal customer profile
   

  

 Can perform competitive analysis and counter positioning to drive adoption in the marketplace
   

  

**Within 90 Days, You’ll:**

* Gain a strong technical understanding of the Sitetracker product and capabilities
* Be able to articulate the value Sitetracker provides to our customers, the problems we solve, the people we solve them for, and the market segments we’re in

* Be deeply involved in product discovery, uncovering and validating business problems, and iteratively defining solutions
* Drive the delivery of several current roadmap items


**Within 365 Days, You’ll:**
* Be a subject matter expert in the market, our business, and our product

* Have visibly and measurably levelled up our Product Management operational excellence

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager for our AI Platform to drive the execution and delivery of Aurigo's proprietary AI foundation model, agent framework, and the AI platform layer that powers our products. This is a hands\-on product role that operates at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise software, and capital program workflows. You will partner closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to define, build, and ship AI capabilities that are safe, measurable, and impactful in enterprise environments. Unlike the Director role which is focused on strategy, vision, and stakeholder leadership, this role is about deep execution. You will own specific product areas end to end, write detailed requirements, drive sprint\-level delivery, and ensure that AI products meet well\-defined quality and safety standards before reaching customers. You will also engage with customers and internal product teams to ground your decisions in real\-world use cases.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Own and execute the product roadmap for assigned areas of the AI platform, including the ingestion and context layer, orchestration layer, agent framework components, and the Copilot experience across all product lines.
* Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI features, and drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking in close partnership with engineering and machine learning teams.
* Define and maintain the evaluation framework for assigned AI features including offline evals, benchmark metrics, regression tests, and production monitoring. No agent or model capability ships without defined success criteria.
* Own the responsible AI execution process at the feature level, including guardrail testing, safety checklists, bias review, and auditability verification before any AI capability reaches customers.
* Serve as the internal AI platform expert for Senior Product Managers across all product lines, providing guidance on how to correctly integrate, specify, and evaluate AI capabilities within their respective workflows.
* Contribute to the model management and MCP server roadmap by gathering data on provider performance, cost, and quality, and by identifying integration opportunities and validating tool specifications.
* Engage with enterprise customers to gather feedback on AI feature performance, understand adoption patterns, and translate insights into roadmap decisions.
* Monitor the competitive landscape for relevant AI product developments, agent frameworks, and enterprise AI tooling, and bring insights into prioritization discussions.



  





**Soft Skills**

* Clear and precise communicator. Able to write requirements, specs, and documentation that engineering teams can act on without repeated clarification.
* Customer empathy. Listens carefully to enterprise customer feedback and translates nuanced qualitative input into actionable product decisions.
* High ownership mindset. Takes accountability for feature quality, safety, and customer outcomes, not just delivery of scope.
* Structured problem\-solver. Breaks ambiguous AI product challenges into well\-defined hypotheses, experiments, and evaluation plans.
* Stays current with fast\-moving developments in foundation models, agentic architectures, and enterprise AI deployment patterns.



  





**Hard Skills** 



* Strong understanding of the AI product development lifecycle including data pipelines, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine\-tuning, and agentic system design.
* Experience designing and running AI evaluation frameworks including offline evals, human evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring for AI features.
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles including human\-in\-the\-loop design, fairness considerations, auditability, and guardrail implementation in enterprise settings.
* Working knowledge of model context protocol or equivalent tool\-use and integration frameworks for agentic systems.
* Ability to define and track AI\-specific product metrics including task completion rates, hallucination rates, model latency, cost per inference, and user satisfaction signals.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Familiarity with major foundation model providers and the practical tradeoffs among them in terms of capability, cost, latency, context window, and data privacy.
* Working knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, and embedding\-based retrieval systems relevant to RAG product design.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation tooling such as LLM eval libraries, RAGAS, or equivalent frameworks for measuring AI system performance.
* Understanding of AI orchestration patterns including ReAct loops, multi\-agent coordination, and durable workflow execution for long\-running agent tasks.
* Proficiency with standard product management tools alongside AI\-specific development and observability platforms.



  





**Educational Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. Advanced degree in a relevant discipline is an advantage.

This role ensures that the TPSRM product meets business needs throughout all lifecycle stages covering Onboarding, Due Diligence, Contracting, Continuous Monitoring, and Offboarding, including inherent risk segmentation, assessment methodologies, contract control requirements, monitoring logic, and decommissioning processes. The role defines product strategy, roadmaps, and enhancement priorities, ensuring TPSRM tooling integrates seamlessly with TPRM, Procurement, Legal, and Information Security systems.


The Product Lead partners closely with the Third\-Party Security Risk Operations Lead, ensuring that operations teams have the tools, workflows, training, and data necessary to efficiently execute assessments, remediation governance, issue tracking, continuous monitoring, and offboarding activities. The role also ensures that KPIs, KRIs, dashboards, and reporting capabilities are robust, reliable, and aligned to enterprise governance.


**Role Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the Third\-Party Security Risk Product, including its roadmap, features, workflows, assessment templates, inherent risk models, and integration points across the third party lifecycle.

* Define and maintain contractual security requirements and support Procurement and Legal during supplier contracting, including ensuring correct control clauses, remediation plans, and risk acceptance criteria.
* Drive technology enablement, including workflow automation, integrations (e.g., TPRM systems, procurement tools, GRC platforms), analytics, and dashboards to improve process efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Continuously improve TPSRM capabilities by monitoring emerging risks, regulatory changes, threat trends, and industry best practices, ensuring the product evolves to maintain strong security outcomes and strategic alignment.

***Why you?***

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Business, Risk, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Experience in Third Party Security Risk Management or Supplier Risk programs.
* 12 \-18 years of relevant experience.
* Experience working with TPRM platforms and GRC tools.
* Experience managing Third\-Party Risk Management tools, such as OneTrust and UpGuard.
* Experience working with assessment questionnaires, security standards, and supplier engagement.
* Experience managing or improving workflows, templates, automation, or GRC tools that support third‑party risk.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Business Analyst – AI & Analytics - IMMEDIATE JOINER
jobs.description:
**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking a Business Analyst – AI \& Analytics to act as the critical bridge between Analytics Product Management (discovery) and Delivery teams (execution). This role focuses on translating business needs into actionable delivery artifacts across data science, data engineering, and visualization teams within a fast\-paced analytics environment.
 



**Role Operating Model** 




 Analytics Product Manager: Leads and owns the discovery phase, manages the product lifecycle, and is accountable for delivering business value and driving adoption post go\-live. Defines the vision, prioritizes the backlog, and articulates what the solution needs to achieve and how it should behave.
 



**Business Analyst (This Role):** 
 Translates prioritized requirements into detailed, actionable work items (user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria) across data science, data engineering, and visualization. Ensures backlog readiness and supports effort estimation in close partnership with the Product Manager. Partners with the Product Manager to support product lifecycle activities, including measuring value realization and driving adoption post go\-live.
 



 Delivery Manager: Organizes work into sprints, ensures delivery commitments are met, manages project budgets, leads daily delivery standups, oversees stakeholder communication during delivery, and works with the delivery team to provide alternatives, address technical challenges, and remove roadblocks.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Business Requirements \& Translation
 



 \- Partner with Product Managers to translate discovery outputs into execution\-ready backlog
 



 \- Create detailed user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria
 



 \- Ensure backlog clarity, completeness, and prioritization readiness
 



  





 Stakeholder Management
 



 \- Act as liaison between business, product, and delivery teams
 



 \- Facilitate workshops and requirement sessions
 



 \- Ensure alignment across stakeholders
 



  





 AI/ML \& Data Science Enablement
 



 \- Translate business problems into AI/ML/LLM use cases
 



 \- Define features, KPIs, and evaluation metrics with data science teams
 



 \- Support model testing, validation, and business adoption
 



  





 Data \& Platform Collaboration
 



 \- Work with Data Engineering to define data pipelines and transformations
 



 \- Ensure clarity around data sources, lineage, and quality
 



 \- Support development in Databricks and visualization tools such as Power BI
 



  





 Visualization \& Insights
 



 \- Design and validate dashboards and reporting solutions
 



 \- Translate analytics into actionable insights and recommendations
 



 \- Drive adoption through business storytelling and enablement
 



  





 Supply Chain Analytics
 



 \- Support use cases in demand forecasting, inventory, logistics, and planning
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 \- 3–6\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in analytics/data\-driven environments
 



 \- Strong supply chain domain knowledge
 



 \- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
 



 \- Strong requirements elicitation and user story writing skills
 



 \- Understanding of AI/ML concepts and lifecycle
 



 \- SQL and data analysis capabilities
 



 \- Experience with Power BI and/or Databricks
 



 \- Excel (Power User level)
 



 \- SharePoint proficiency
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 




 \- MBA or relevant certifications (CBAP, PMI\-PBA, Agile BA, etc.) are advantageous
 



 \- Experience working on analytics, machine learning, AI, or digital transformation projects preferred
 



 \- Background in Analytics / MIS (Management Information Systems) preferred
 



**Nice to Have** 




 \- Python programming
 



 \- Familiarity with data science workflows
 



 \- Experience with Power Automate
 



**Success Metrics** 




 \- High\-quality, delivery\-ready backlog with minimal rework
 



 \- Strong alignment between product intent and delivered solution
 



 \- Timely and predictable delivery cycles
 



 \- Stakeholder satisfaction and adoption of analytics solutions
 



 \- Measurable impact on business KPIs
 



**What We Value** 




 \- Ability to operate in ambiguity and translate it into clarity
 



 \- Strong collaboration across technical and business teams
 



 \- Delivery\-focused mindset
 



 \- Structured problem\-solving and systems thinking
 



 \- Strong communication and storytelling skills
